responsibility: This header declares the optional preprocessing interface for the mc front end. It exports the single procedure that runs the configured C preprocessor on a source module when requested and returns the filename to read thereafter, abstracting temporary-file creation and cleanup behind a simple source-to-source hook.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the minimal API front for GmcPreprocess.cc, declaring only the source-to-source preprocessing entry point and hiding the temporary-file and cleanup implementation details.
